newsitem.title: UK: NWE prompt gasoline eases lower, June/July firms.
newsitem.headline: NWE prompt gasoline eases lower, June/July firms.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Wednesday after the market failed to recover early losses made in the wake of bearish U.S. stocks data.
Eurograde barges traded $2.00 to $3.00 a tonne lower at $200.50 and $199.25 a tonne fob ARA.
But regular unleaded barge traded firmer at $192.75 a tonne, narrowing slightly the wide differential between the two grades.

The slide on the physical market was reflected in a general easing of swaps values. But a firming of the June/July backwardation was attributed to first signs of hoarding in the U.K. before an expected tax hike in the post-election budget.
